intro.narration: [excited] Heey — what's fifty-three times sixty-seven? [pause] In your head, in one move.

steps.narration: [curious] Do not multiply yet. [pause] Look at where these two numbers meet.
[confident] Both are seven away from sixty. [pause] Sixty is the middle, seven is the gap.
steps.instruction: Find the number in the middle

steps.narration: [confident] Square sixty, subtract seven squared. [pause] Thirty-six hundred minus forty-nine.
steps.instruction: Square it, take off the gap²

steps.narration: [excited] Three thousand five hundred fifty-one. [pause] That is the product.
[thoughtful] Odd sum? [pause] No middle. Shift by one, then add fifty-three back.
steps.instruction: Odd sum? No middle — shift by one
